description: This Java class 'TbMsgProcessingCtx' manages message processing context, including a counter and a stack of processing items, with serialization/deserialization to protobuf.

classes.name: TbMsgProcessingCtx
classes.description: Immutable message processing context class with a counter and a stack, supporting serialization to and from protobuf.

methods.name: getAndIncrementRuleNodeCounter
methods.description: Returns the current value of the rule node execution counter and increments it atomically.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current context, including the stack if present.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a new processing stack item onto the stack with specified RuleChainId and RuleNodeId.

methods.name: isAlreadyInStack
methods.description: Checks if a given RuleChainId and RuleNodeId are already in the stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last item from the stack.

methods.name: fromProto
methods.description: Creates a TbMsgProcessingCtx instance from its protobuf representation.

methods.name: toProto
methods.description: Serializes the context to its protobuf representation.
